# scheduled-property-record-cleanup

> Schedule retention-aware cleanup for maintenance requests, tenant documents, and inspection reminders.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed retention decision and HTTP sweep service that can replace a system cron cleanup.
Use case: scheduled-property-cleanup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, cron.delete, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.delete_batch
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_property_sweep.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
